welcome.title: Welcome to TrackGeek!
welcome.description: Let's take a quick tour of the main places: the feed, your progress, search and how to add things to it. You can leave at any time.

tabs.title: The feed
tabs.description: This is where activity shows up. Following has what the people you follow are doing, Global shows everyone, and Trending shows what is getting attention.

composer.title: Share something
composer.description: Write a post, attach a title or a screenshot, and share it with the community. Others can react and comment.

sidebar.title: Keep going
sidebar.description: Titles you are in the middle of watching or reading show up here, so you can pick up right where you stopped.

userMenu.title: Your account menu
userMenu.description: Your profile, notifications, settings and this tour live here. Let's open your profile next.

tabs.title: Your profile
tabs.description: Each tab shows a different side of your account. Once you track something, a Progress tab appears with everything you are watching, reading or playing.

stats.title: Your progress at a glance
stats.description: Counters for each type of media. Click one to jump to the full list for that type.

sections.title: Organized by status
sections.description: Your progress is split by status, like in progress, planned, completed, paused and dropped. Pick one to see its titles.

filters.title: Find things fast
filters.description: Search inside your progress, sort it and filter by genre, year and more.

xp.title: Levels and coins
xp.description: Tracking things earns XP and coins. Level up, unlock medals and spend coins in the shop.

type.title: Choose what to look for
type.description: Search movies, TV shows, anime, manga, games and books, as well as cast and other users.

input.title: Search
input.description: Type a name to see results and use the filters to narrow them down. Open any title to continue the tour and see how to add it to your progress.

status.title: Add it to your progress
status.description: Pick a status to add this title to your progress. After that you can update episodes, chapters or hours, rate it and write a review.

userMenu.title: All done
userMenu.description: Everything you add shows up in your profile and in the feed. You can replay this tour from the account menu at any time.

pwa.installDescription: Add TrackGeek to your home screen for a faster, app-like experience.
pwa.installIOS: Tap <share /> in the browser bar, then choose "Add to Home Screen".
